ingest.idea_text: AI agent that chases unpaid invoices for independent consultants

plan.name: independent-accounting-practices
plan.description: Solo/small accounting and bookkeeping practices (2-10 staff) that invoice clients monthly
plan.why: Invoicing and collections are core recurring pain for billable-hours firms

plan.name: fractional-cfo-firms
plan.description: Fractional CFO / virtual controller firms handling many small clients
plan.why: Fractional operators own collections for many clients; leverage per saved hour is highest

plan.name: boutique-creative-agencies
plan.description: Boutique creative/marketing agencies with retainers and milestone invoicing
plan.why: Retainer billing disputes are common and visible in hiring signals (billing/invoice roles)

analyze.problem_statement: Fractional CFO firms struggle to recover unpaid invoices from clients in a timely manner because follow-up requires persistent, personalized outreach that pulls senior practitioners away from billable advisory work; the current workaround is manual email and phone follow-up by the CFO or an admin, which costs billable hours, delayed cash flow, and strained client relationships. Hypothesis: an AI agent that autonomously sequences, personalizes, and escalates invoice follow-up communications removes that time and cash-flow cost for fractional CFO firms managing collections across multiple client engagements.
analyze.rationale: Proceed: run 10 interviews in 'fractional-cfo-firms' (score 70, ~1487124 companies show the ICP, 2089 competitors).
